basics.name: Shantanu Nath
basics.label: Researcher & Engineer
basics.summary: Researcher and engineer working at the intersection of NLP, multimodal learning, and healthcare AI. Currently a Research Fellow at the University of Trento, Italy.

work.name: Trakti
work.summary: Engineered end-to-end multi-document summarization pipelines, built production RAG systems with hybrid search, and developed continuous LLM evaluation frameworks using RAGAS and TruLens.

work.name: University of Trento
work.summary: Designed end-to-end system to classify lung ultrasound videos and investigated XAI evaluation metrics using LIME and attention mechanisms.

work.name: University of Trento — CIMeC
work.summary: Examined how removing linguistic properties from text affects alignment between LLMs and fMRI brain responses. Trained LSTM and GPT-2 models to extract language representations and map them to fMRI signals.

work.name: Fondazione Bruno Kessler
work.summary: Applied research at one of Italy's leading research institutions.

work.name: Eutech Systems Limited
work.summary: Designed and deployed machine learning models for production environments. Worked on NLP and computer vision solutions.

education.institution: University of Groningen & University of Trento

awards.title: Erasmus Mundus Scholarship
awards.summary: Full scholarship for the Language and Communication Technologies joint master's program.

awards.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge — Global Finalist
awards.summary: Selected among global finalists in the NASA Space Apps Challenge hackathon.
